question: Can every candidate on the pinned declaration surface be retained as a checkable reference? Only then, is there one declared route satisfying A, B, C and D for the same request?
level: Static documentary inventory and bounded human-readable review. No semantic execution.

predecessor.history_policy: Immutable. Its one run is spent. This separately dated contract has its own single attempt.

machine.selection: exact dependencies/adva-machine.lock.json revision; later commits and pull requests are excluded

objects.required_relation: versioned request -> two checked diagram admissions -> exact qualified source/occurrence/path endpoint check -> receiver outcome
objects.arithmetic_domain: The literal 1/1 remains serialized Rational data. Additive zero, multiplicative unity, inverses, commutation and arithmetic truth are not queried.

selection_grammar.root_anchor_rule: A path matches only when it has the same segment count as the pattern and each path segment matches the corresponding pattern segment. Wildcards never cross slash boundaries and suffix matches are excluded.
selection_grammar.catalog_closure: Every repository-relative file named by spec/catalog.json files, plus the catalog itself.
selection_grammar.exclusions: Directories, symlinks, submodules, evidence snapshots, target products and every path not selected by the exact grammar are excluded. Any selected evidence path is a preflight refusal.

candidate_rule: Same ordered TERMS, casefold substring, splitlines, one row per hit line. Import the frozen predecessor preflight and constants. Never invoke its search() or main().

budget.memory: Measure driver child ru_maxrss when available; do not substitute file size for memory.

environment: Designate exactly one clean, quiescent, locked Linux checkout of adva-machine and one Adva working directory based on the predecessor. POSIX local filesystem with same-directory rename, file/dir fsync, fork/wait4 and an available timer. Separate repos; no dependency build, imports, fixture reads or GitHub Actions. A copied working directory, deletion of the guard, or any alternate output root never grants another attempt.
freeze_and_attempt: Record the contract SHA-256 externally before production. Driver verifies the contract and all input pins. mkdir at the fixed evidence path consumes the single attempt before worker startup. Fixture-only fault injection is separate. No retry, cleanup of the guard, or second scan after an I/O failure, timeout, or supervisor loss.

capture.manifest: Sorted path, byte count, SHA-256 for every selected file, including no-hit files. Historic aggregate hashes the compact JSON array without LF. Physical file includes final LF and has its own digest and byte count.
capture.ledger: Stream canonical ASCII JSONL with exactly path, 1-based line and ordered unique terms. Capture uses zero stdout bytes. No dependency source excerpts, source-derived snippets, request serialization or reversible source encodings.
capture.commit: Temporary files in the fixed attempt directory, flush/fsync, atomic rename, fsync directory. Persist manifest before content search. Recheck every search input against its manifest. Re-read ledger and manifest before receipt. Completion requires receipt plus successful independent supervisor exit bound to its SHA-256, and offline verify. Ignore .tmp files and partial published components.
capture.check: Compare readback with producer count/bytes/SHA-256, pinned 71-file manifest and 430-line historical cross-check. Check canonical bytes, schema, order, uniqueness, manifest membership, line bounds and term vocabulary. Count agreement alone cannot verify retention. Hashes are integrity pins, not signatures.

failures.before_content: Preflight invariant or file failure -> Unknown / RefusedBeforeSearch.
failures.during_content: Source read/decode/hash, term matching, hit bound or search deadline -> Unknown / RefusedDuringSearch. Preserve manifest.
failures.capture: Sink, serialization, byte quota, count mismatch, fsync/rename, readback or missing durable evidence -> Unknown / EvidenceCaptureFailure. No complete result on partial artifacts.
failures.abrupt: Killed/timed-out/lost supervisor: Unknown, retain last durable phase, attempt, worker status when available. No replay.

review_gate.start: Only after clean capture + offline verify; pin receipt hash outside attempt. Use pinned manifest paths and line numbers, read static source locally in the dependency checkout. Context reading of retained locations and declarations on the selected surface is allowed; no second term search or fixture access.
required: A: versioned frozen opaque request or lossless typed equivalent
B: two checked native diagram admissions on that route
C: qualified source/occurrence/path endpoint check on that route
D: receiver outcome on that route
review_gate.coverage: Assign a disposition to every ledger row keyed by path and line. May share a rationale only for explicitly identified references on the same declaration/profile. Bind review to ledger digest; require distinct keys with exact ledger coverage. Record four judgments, partial routes and gaps. Components from unrelated routes cannot be combined.
review_gate.decision: A positive needs one executable route, versioned input/output declarations, replay entry and four witnesses. A negative needs all references reviewed, all plausible compositions checked on the selected surface, with missing obligations; only NoExactRouteWithinSelectedSurface. Otherwise Unknown. Runtime outcomes NotRun.

negative_controls: sink failure/short or silently truncated evidence
preflight file missing versus post-manifest source I/O, decode or digest errors
nonclaims: The selected surface is deliberately narrower than the complete machine repository.
Declaration presence does not establish successful runtime execution; declaration absence outside this surface is not tested.
The merged predecessor is adva history, not independent adva-machine authority.
Python may inventory declarations but cannot create semantic identities or certify native behavior.
A primitive importer, generic request command, documentary transport route or text match is not the required composed receiving route.
Research 0090 coverage remains open; Research 0092 promotion remains blocked; local image equality creates no M6 filler; Research 0123 words remain Proposed.
authorship: Original first-party work by Codex (OpenAI), offered under Unknown v0.3. Any authorized GitHub submission would use Mingli Yuan's account as proxy; it does not imply his authorship, review or endorsement.
